ruled_under: R-85 (admissibility), R-91 (admissible must evaluate a coordinator-set rule)
field: p_book(r) = UP-space mid at knowledge time T-r, read from the price_change spine

requirements.source: price_change spine only; book snapshots are subscription-triggered and not time-uniform
requirements.comment: THE BOUND IS THE RUNG'S OWN VALUE. Adopted from measurement, not chosen: a read labelled 'r seconds before T' may not be older than r, or the label names a window position the quote predates. No free parameter, so nothing here can be tuned after a result is visible.

on_fail_comment: R-85: committed days keep demoted labels rather than retro-refusal. The row survives as a stale-quote observation; only the r-indexed freshness reading is refused.

measured_yield_at_authoring.corpus: committed calib_panel, 36,288 rows, 14 coin-days, generation pinned

what_the_measurement_says: Staleness is monotone in r and collapses at r>=120: the book goes quiet in the final minute, so every short rung reads the same pre-quiet quote. This is a property of the venue's quote process, not of the rule. That an honest bound refuses most of the r<=60 panel is information about the panel.
